title: Augustinus: Enarrationes in Psalmos 110-118
subtitle: Enarrationes in Psalmos 110-118
author: Augustinus
description: As part of the first critical edition of Augustine s commentary on the Psalms, the edition of Expositions on Psalms 101 150 was developed in collaboration between the CSEL and the Istituto Patristico Augustinianum (Rome). This volume completes the sub-project, developed by Franco Gori together with Angelo De Nicola."
